shared_elements: large quadruped-like figure with four legs
possible human/anthropomorphic figure adjacent to the animal
elongated projecting element (staff/limb) held out to one side
justification: Both surfaces plausibly show a large four-legged animal with an accompanying upright figure and a projecting stick-like element, but that is a generic pairing any tradition could produce, and B's subject is not even securely identifiable as the same animal. The depictions differ fundamentally in convention: A is a modelled, naturalistic profile scene of a humped camel led by a robed attendant above a repeating rosette border, while B is a single stark linear outline figure with no border, no ground line and no anatomical detail.
